message:
Command `cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'python3 -c "
driver = chr(10).join([
    \"#include <stdint.h>\",
    \"#include <stdio.h>\",
    \"#include <stdlib.h>\",
    \"int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);\",
    \"int main(int argc, char** argv) {\",
    \"    if(argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, \\\"usage: %s <input_file>\\\\n\\\", argv[0]); return 1; }\",
    \"    FILE* f = fopen(argv[1], \\\"rb\\\");\",
    \"    if(!f) { perror(\\\"fopen\\\"); return 1; }\",
    \"    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);\",
    \"    long sz = ftell(f);\",
    \"    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);\",
    \"    uint8_t* buf = malloc(sz);\",
    \"    if(fread(buf, 1, sz, f) != (size_t)sz) { perror(\\\"fread\\\"); return 1; }\",
    \"    fclose(f);\",
    \"    LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(buf, sz);\",
    \"    free(buf);\",
    \"    return 0;\",
    \"}\",
])
with open(\"/tmp/test_driver.c\", \"w\") as f:
    f.write(driver)
print(\"Driver written\")
"'` executed with exit code 0.
